headline: Constitutional questions
description: <p>PAKISTAN has had three constitutions. Two given to it by its people in 1956 and 1973. One promulgated by a field marshal in 1962. The 1973 Constitution was adopted by the people through their representatives in the constituent assembly. Article 1 states that Pakistan shall be a federal republic. Neither the term “federal” nor “republic” is expressly defined. The Objectives Resolution provides guidance.</p> <p>The power and authority of the state in our republic is to be exercised through the chosen representatives of the people. A republic is distinct from rule by one man.
